power.title: Power
power.description: Main power input for the controller.
power.connectTo: 24V DC industrial power supply (screw terminal, reverse-polarity protected).

ethernet1.title: Ethernet (1)
ethernet1.connectTo: RJ45 Ethernet cable to a PC, switch, or local network.

ethernet2.title: Ethernet (2)
ethernet2.description: Second Ethernet interface, e.g. for a redundant link or a separate field network.
ethernet2.connectTo: RJ45 Ethernet cable to a PC, switch, or local network.

usb.title: USB
usb.description: USB host port for external storage or peripherals.
usb.connectTo: USB flash drive, keyboard, or other USB device.

audioIn.title: Audio In
audioIn.connectTo: External microphone or line-level audio source.

audioOut.title: Audio Out
audioOut.connectTo: Speaker, amplifier, or line-level audio input.

sdcard.title: SD Card
sdcard.description: Removable storage for the Linux root filesystem, logs, or firmware images.
sdcard.connectTo: microSD card, class 10 or better recommended.

modules.title: Modules (expansion bay)
modules.description: Expansion bay. The controller auto-detects which module or field-bus interface is plugged in via its ADC identification channel. When an RS-485 interface is detected, right-click to open its serial configuration.
modules.connectTo: Any compatible expansion module (relay module, analog input module, RS-485/RS-232/CAN interface).
